prologue.skytest.title: Vision
prologue.skytest.line1: Cast off the shackles of sleep.
prologue.skytest.line2: The time has come for you to ascend.
prologue.skytest.line3: Find me at the top of the world.
area.skytest.lower_prison.subtitle: The very bottom of the world
area.skytest.test_end.subtitle: Test area complete. To be continued...
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.1: Hush... Don't get up so fast.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.2: You slept a long time. Longer than anyone I have ever kept here.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.3: You needn't answer. I know words were not given to you.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.4: But your eyes speak. The light came to you in your sleep, didn't it?
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.5: It only speaks to those who are meant to rise.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.6: Catch your breath. When you're ready, come to me again.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.1: This is the Lower Prison. The very bottom of the world.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.2: They throw down here those whom the world above wants to forget. Throw them down, and forget.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.3: No one has ever climbed out. I have watched them try.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.4: You're looking up... So you've decided. Very well. Listen closely.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.1: Your door is not locked. I saw to that. Don't ask what it cost me.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.2: In the open cell down the corridor lie old boots.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.3: Their owner once danced beneath the circus dome. He won't need them anymore.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.4: Past the corridor is a great hall. On the ledge lies a bone hand on a chain.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.5: It will help you cling to life. Quite literally.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.farewell.1: Go. My light will wait for you here.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.farewell.2: If you lose your way, come back to it.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.1: Oh! Another lucky one. I didn't think anyone would get out of their cell before me.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.2: Silent? Good. The walls here listen more closely than people do.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.3: You see, this prison isn't just a pit. It's a mechanism. Halls and corridors shift like gears in a clock.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.4: The Regulator moves them. Somewhere above he turns his levers, and passages open... or vanish.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.5: Only he hasn't touched those levers in a very long time. The ways up are blocked, and he won't move a single block any time soon.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.6: So everyone finds their own way. I'll find mine. You find yours.
dialogue.skytest.stranger.meeting.7: Catch! It won't cut anyone down anymore, but it's enough to fend them off. Good luck, lucky one!
area.skytest.sky_bridge.subtitle: The prison hangs above the clouds. Below, only sky.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.6: And don't be squeamish about rats. Down here, there is no other food.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.1: Hmm... Footsteps. It has been long since anyone crossed the bridge alive.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.2: Don't be afraid. I am no warden. I am the Regulator. These are my levers, my chains, my halls.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.3: Pull one, and somewhere above a corridor turns. Pull another, and a path opens that was not there yesterday.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.4: You want to go up, don't you? I see it in your eyes. Everyone wants to go up.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.5: I would gladly turn the paths for you. Truly.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.6: But I have no strength to even lift a hand... Larpi ran away.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.7: Larpi is my rat. Small, grey, with a white spot on her ear. She always sat on my shoulder while I worked.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.8: Without her the levers won't listen. Or I won't listen to them... I don't know.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.meeting.9: Find her, silent one. Bring Larpi back, and I will move the whole prison for you.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.waiting.2: They say someone breeds rats down below the cells. Maybe she ran there.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.waiting.3: Look for the white spot on her ear. You won't mistake her for any other.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.waiting.4: If you find her, carry her gently. She bites when she's frightened.
area.skytest.regulator_hall.subtitle: From here the whole prison moves
quest.skytest.find_larpi.objective: Find Larpi. They say someone breeds rats below the cells
area.skytest.upper_tier.subtitle: Where they keep those even the wardens fear
quest.skytest.find_larpi.objective.1: Find Larpi among the Rat Catcher's rats: hold the bait and right-click a rat
quest.skytest.find_larpi.caught: You have Larpi! Take her to the Regulator.
quest.skytest.find_larpi.wrong_rat: Not her. The rat snatched the bait and nipped your finger.
story.skytest.bridge_moved: Somewhere above the abyss a bridge grinds into a new place
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.idle.1: Shh... don't stomp. Can't you see they're sleeping?
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.idle.2: I'm the Rat Catcher. Don't worry, I don't catch them anymore. Now I... herd them.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.idle.3: If you see the Regulator, tell him his machines hum too loud.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.1: Shh! Don't stomp. They just fell asleep... well, almost.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.2: A guest? A living guest? Nobody's come down here in ages. Only them, and me.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.3: Rat Catcher. That is what the guards called me. I caught them, yes. And then... I got attached.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.4: A white spot on the ear, you say? The Regulator's? There was a new one. Joined my lot a few days ago.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.5: But I can't tell her apart: my eyes aren't what they were, and there are a dozen of them, all equally cheeky.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.6: Here's the thing. Take this bait. Hold it in your hand and mine will come running.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.7: And the proud one, the one that won't come to a stranger's hand, that's yours. Walk up and offer her the bait.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.meeting.8: And don't you dare hit them. Crush one and I'll chew your ears off myself.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.waiting.2: Don't look at the one climbing into your hands. Look at the one sitting off to the side.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.waiting.3: I'll give you more bait, I don't mind. Mine love it more than me anyway.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.thanks.1: Found her, then. Look at her, sitting in your coat like she belongs there.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.thanks.2: Take her to the Regulator. Maybe the giant will finally move the bridges. His chains keep mine awake.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.thanks.3: Drop by sometime. Rats love guests. Especially ones with bait.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.after.1: Heard that rumble up there? You must have delivered her.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.after.2: Go on. Mine say hello. Or they don't. Who can tell.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.larpi.2: Come here, little one. Come... You're shaking. Where have you been?
dialogue.skytest.regulator.larpi.3: Down below, with the Rat Catcher? Oh, that old man. He lures every rat in the prison.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.larpi.4: I promised, and I remember. The paths will change.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.larpi.5: See the levers? Now... this one. And this one. Hold on tight.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.larpi.6: The bridge to the Upper Tier is back in place. Go. But remember: up there they keep those we down here were afraid of.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.to_lower.1: Larpi is happy. So I am happy.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.to_lower.2: Want to go back down, to the cells? That span is taken apart now: the bridge holds only one road at a time.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.to_lower.3: No matter. I'll turn it. And if you want to go up again, come back and I'll turn it again.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.to_upper.1: Up again? Larpi says you looked good up there.
dialogue.skytest.regulator.to_upper.2: I'll take away the span to the cells: the bridge holds only one road at a time.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.idle.4: The far cell by the wall held the Digger. Scratched and scratched all night... then one night he stopped. They say he got out.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.waiting.4: And another thing. The far cell by the wall held the Digger. Scratched and scratched all night... then one night he stopped. They say he got out.
dialogue.skytest.rat_catcher.after.3: The far cell by the wall held the Digger. Scratched and scratched all night... then one night he stopped. They say he got out.
